---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool, capability or behavior change
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that brain-v42 doesn't support today? Describe
the underlying problem, not just the solution you have in mind.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. If it changes an MCP tool's contract,
touches the schema, or adds a new killswitch, say so explicitly — those
changes need design discussion before a pull request, not after.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't pick them (including
"do nothing" if relevant).

## Trust model impact

Does this touch network exposure, authentication, or secret handling? See
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the trust model this project assumes
before proposing anything that changes it.

## Additional context

Anything else — related issues, prior art in similar tools, etc.
